builds.kind: closeout pass over two parallel lanes (vertical rhythm / truncation vocabulary), driven by OBSERVED.md browser evidence
builds.$note: NOT a new build. Same 'The Proof Sheet' macrostructure; does not reset the gate 8/32 variation clock. This entry records the merge of the two lanes that answered OBSERVED.md D1/D2/D3, plus the leftovers each lane handed to this pass and four defects found while cross-reading their outputs.
builds.knobsChanged: sectionRhythm — the knob's value changed (see below); the knob itself is the same one.

lanesMerged.rhythm: app/globals.css + components/ui/SectionShell.tsx + all 17 sections. Vertical whitespace now has exactly one owner: pb is --spacing-tail everywhere, pt is a three-step RHYTHM record exported from SectionShell. A boundary is therefore tail + the NEXT section's pt, decided in one place instead of emerging from two symmetric paddings. At 1440px: setpiece 104px / flow 192px / movement 312px — spread widened from 1.5x to 3.0x. The `bare` prop is gone; the seven hand-laid sections import RHYTHM rather than writing py-*. SEC/09 also gained a fourth lg column (the package list, lifted out of the body's disclosure) so the right third carries load.
lanesMerged.truncation: New components/ui/ScrollEdge.tsx replaces CodeBlock's background scroll-shadow. Root cause of OBSERVED D1 confirmed at the source: the old shading was painted on `background`, which renders BEHIND the <code> text, so no amount of it could stop `overflow` from shearing the glyphs — the vocabulary existed in the stylesheet but was structurally incapable of appearing on screen. mask-image acts on content instead, and two @property lengths driven by animation-timeline: scroll(self) zero out the near edge at each end. hero-svml and svrun-candidate rewrapped to a 51-column budget; S7 lost both nested vertical scrollbars; the .trace-run marquee was replaced by a static 1.5px stroke.

closeoutEdits.issue: The truncation lane unified the three scrollers inside S7 and then declared ScrollEdge 'the site's only truncation vocabulary', but three site-wide scrollers were still shearing text bare: DataTable (min-width 44rem, used in S7/S8/S10), Terminal's log body (used in S9 twice) and S5's affinity table (min-width 34rem). The defect OBSERVED found in S7 was reachable in four other sections.
closeoutEdits.resolution: All three now carry X_SCROLL. DataTable needed restructuring rather than a class: mask-image's positioning area is the border box, so hanging it on the bordered wrapper would have eaten the table's own right-hand 1px rule along with the text. Border and width stay on the outer div; a new inner div is the scroller. Terminal and HookAnchors had no border on the scrolling element, so the class alone was safe.

closeoutEdits.issue: `.trace-run` and `@keyframes run` (plus their reduced-motion override) had zero consumers after the S7 marquee was removed.
closeoutEdits.resolution: Deleted all three blocks; the comment in GraphSeparation.tsx that explains why the marquee went away now says the CSS went with it.

closeoutEdits.issue: The header comment justified skipping the scroll-driven animation under prefers-reduced-motion by claiming globals forces `animation-duration: .001ms`. It does not — globals deliberately uses var(--dur-fast) with iteration-count 1, and says so.
closeoutEdits.resolution: Comment rewritten to the real reason: under that media query the timeline is reinterpreted as time, so the fade width decouples from scroll position.

closeoutEdits.issue: Stale constants and comments left by the two lanes: Hero still documented an 18-line reveal after hero-svml grew to 22; Team/TeamLog's `sec` prop docs advertised defaults of 16/17 against actual defaults of 15/16; S5 hand-wrote a heading size string byte-identical to TITLE_SCALE.movement instead of importing it, the exact drift the single-source rule exists to prevent.
closeoutEdits.resolution: Hero's beat comment recomputed (0.78 + 21x0.022 + DUR.base = 1.46s, still inside HERO_SETTLE_MS = 1500 — checked, not assumed); doc defaults corrected; S5 now imports TITLE_SCALE.movement.

crossCheck.sectionOrder: data-sec 01..17, no gaps, no duplicates. 01 Hero (literal), 02-10 via SectionShell's sec prop, 11/12/13/14/17 literal, 15/16 via pad(sec,2) defaults.
crossCheck.hudTotal: still derived — activeSection.ts counts document.querySelectorAll('[data-section][data-sec]'); HudFrame renders that count. Nothing hardcodes 17.
crossCheck.navAnchors: #what -> S2, #hook -> S5, #graphs -> S7, #paradigms -> S11, #team -> S15; all five ids exist on the corresponding section elements.
crossCheck.railSwitchPoints: SprocketRail.modeForSec cuts at 5 / 7 / 11 / 15 / 17, identical to nav.items' fromSec (2,5,7,11,15) plus the epilogue. Four systems agree.
crossCheck.navHighlightBoundary: OBSERVED D3 fixed at the source: Nav reads heldSec from the one site-wide observer over all 17 sections and folds it to a movement via the last item whose fromSec <= current, so S8-S10 resolve to BUILD by derivation and the footer holds at PEOPLE (17) instead of freezing on whichever of five anchors was last seen.
crossCheck.factRedLines: no 'DUCK protocol' (architecture.ts names the construct Candidate and only quotes Martelli's duck-typing line); 88 packages consistent across hero.ts and stats.ts; 'Narratage Open Source License' always spelled in full; 唐艺 given only as 16, never a birth year.
crossCheck.bilingual: en/cn key counts equal in every file under lib/data and every section/ui component (script-checked, zero mismatches).
crossCheck.accent: crimson only. ScrollEdge introduces no colour at all — the mask is achromatic.
crossCheck.spacingScale: the four new rhythm tokens land on multiples of 4 at both ends of --spacing-section's clamp (80px -> 24/28/68/128, 160px -> 48/56/136/256). Between those ends the token is fluid by design, so gate 24 is satisfied at the endpoints, not at every viewport width.

selfCritique.previous: P5 H4 E4 S5 R4 V5

why.hierarchy: 4 -> 5. The old spread was 1.5x, which is a rounding error a reader cannot feel; signature shots got their emphasis by leaving the ordinary sections empty, which is why OBSERVED measured ~310px of nothing above SEC/09. Now the boundary is a single number with a single owner and a 3.0x spread, and the signature shots get the site's TIGHTEST entrance (104px) rather than the loosest neighbours.
why.execution: held at 4. Not raised, for three reasons stated in residualIssues: the hero still shows about 13 of 22 code lines behind an inner scroll; four of six code samples in lib/data are unreferenced; and nothing in this pass was seen rendering.
why.restraint: 4 -> 5. The one perpetually-moving thing in the viewport (the 3.2s .trace-run marquee) is gone and its CSS with it; the site now has no infinite animation outside the caret. Four horizontal scrollers that each improvised their own truncation now share one.

verification.emittedCssAudit: grepped the production CSS chunk: --spacing-tail and the three --spacing-rhythm-* tokens present; zero occurrences of trace-run. ScrollEdge's rules are correctly absent from the Tailwind chunk — they ship in a React 19 <style href> hoisted at render and deduped by href.
verification.notVerified: No browser, dev server or devtools permitted. Every spacing figure, the 51-column budget and the DataTable border-box reasoning are arithmetic over source constants, not measured renders.

residualIssues: components/sections/Hero.tsx:468 still passes maxHeight="clamp(13rem, 40vh, 26rem)" while hero-svml grew from 18 to 22 lines. At 1440x900 that is 360px of a 588px block: roughly 13 lines visible and 9 behind an inner scroll. The new Y_SCROLL fade at least makes that read as 'more below' instead of a shear, but the hero's headline artefact is now two-thirds hidden. Not changed unilaterally — it is the same art-direction call (fluid vs line-locked height) carried in the two previous entries, and it now also interacts with a copy decision.

lib/data/code-samples.ts still defines full-pipeline (79 cols), script-syntax (73), runtime-profile (86) and svs-recipe (33); grep finds no consumer for any of the four. Only hero-svml and svrun-candidate are rendered. Left in place because deleting them means editing the CodeSampleId union, which is outside a closeout's remit — but they are why the file's new column-budget comment can look contradicted by the data next to it.

components/ui/CodeBlock.tsx still hardcodes CODE_LINE_HEIGHT = 26 to mirror the CSS line box. maxLines' whole-line guarantee, and now also the Y_SCROLL exclusion that rides on it, break silently if the type scale moves.

components/sections/ModelMatrix.tsx:102 keeps a bare overflow-x-auto: it is a snap card carousel below sm and overflow-visible from sm up, so a permanent mask would fade a grid that does not scroll. Card edges are the affordance there. app/not-found.tsx:32 likewise (separate page, one <pre>).
components/sections/ParadigmTable.tsx keeps transition:width on the spine — knowingly retained, argued in the 2026-08-18-proof-sheet entry.
app/layout.tsx metadata description still carries the BP one-liner containing "World's #1".

components/ui/DataTable.tsx was accidentally reformatted by a prettier run with default options during this pass and then reformatted back with --no-semi --single-quote --print-width 100, which reproduces the repo's hand style to within a few line breaks. The file's semantics are unchanged and it typechecks, but its diff is larger than the two-hunk edit it should have been. The repo has no prettier config; one would prevent a repeat.

builds.trigger: Screenshots captured at 1440x900 and 375x812. Three defects were measured, not inferred; one further defect was found by arithmetic while fixing them.

lanes.defect: P0 — the masthead contents bar overflowed its container and was clipped by overflow-x:clip.
lanes.rootCause: max-w-shell resolves to --container-shell: 1280px (not 84rem). Minus lg:px-12 (96px) leaves 1184px usable; the fully expanded single row needs ~1440px at 11px mono with 0.16em tracking. The ml-auto group had no compressible item. Independent of viewport width — the container caps at 1280, so it also overflowed at 1920; 1440 is merely where the viewport began clipping it.
lanes.fix: Contents bar and right rail moved from lg: to xl: (1024-1279 now uses the drawer). New UtilityMenu (SET[+]/SET[-]) demotes THEME and MOTION into a secondary panel: native <button>, aria-expanded/aria-controls, `hidden` removes the closed panel from the tab order, Esc returns focus, outside pointerdown/focusin closes. Version string and the LANG prefix appear only at 2xl. Right rail gap-3 -> gap-2 + shrink-0; movement items px-3 -> px-2 (min-h-11 preserved). Drawer now resets on matchMedia('(min-width: 80rem)') so the body scroll lock cannot survive a resize past the xl breakpoint with no visible close affordance.

lanes.defect: P0 — the hero code block rendered at a per-line decreasing near-zero opacity and never resolved.
lanes.rootCause: Two engines writing the same property. CodeBlock carried a permanent `transition-[background-color,opacity]` on every line span; GSAP's autoAlpha writes inline opacity every frame, and each new value restarted a 320ms CSS transition chasing it, so the rendered value was permanently mid-flight. The from() immediateRender wrote all 18 lines to opacity:0 first, so any interruption (matchMedia rebuild, fonts.ready -> ScrollTrigger.refresh, useGSAP revertOnUpdate) left the block stuck translucent with no self-healing path. NOT caused by a second scrub animation — no ScrollTrigger in Hero binds line opacity to scroll progress.
lanes.fix: CodeBlock now opts into the opacity transition only when dimLines is actually passed (transitionsOpacity). Hero's line reveal rewritten from() -> fromTo() so the end value is explicit rather than inferred from whatever the DOM held at build time, plus clearProps to hand styling back to CSS. A window.setTimeout settle guard (not gsap.delayedCall, which rides the ticker that may itself be stalled by Lenis lagSmoothing(0)) forces the readable end state.
lanes.narrativeCheck: CREATIVE's 'compilation advance' intent is preserved and in fact restored: the per-line staggered reveal is still the beat of compiler output, and the scrub-driven crimson playhead still advances along the ruler. Before this fix the narrative was not merely at risk, it was invisible.

defects: P0 — S3's code card sheared line 16 in half. Arithmetic, not styling: maxHeight 26rem = 416px, minus py-3 (24px) = 392px / 26px line box = 15.07 lines.

P1 — mobile timecodes collided into `00:0000:04`. Traced NOT to SprocketRail (its labels are display:none under 768px) but to Hero's RULER_TICKS: 9 absolutely-positioned labels at left:i/8*100%; at 375px minus px-5 each cell is ~42px while a `00:00` label at 11px mono with 0.12em tracking is ~40px wide, leaving a ~2px gap. Static geometry, not an animation mid-state.
lanes.fix: CodeBlock gained maxLines?: number, converting to an exact height (maxLines * 26px + padding) so any clip necessarily lands on a line boundary; S3 now uses maxLines={15} (414px, within a pixel or two of the original design height). Truncation is signalled with a pure-CSS scroll-shadow (Komarov's two-layer technique: a background-attachment:local paper mask over a scroll-attached ink shadow at color-mix(ink 13%)), which introduces no second accent colour and self-hides when there is nothing to scroll. overscroll-contain added so a mobile scroll-to-end does not carry the page. Ruler density halved below sm (tick.i % 2 !== 0 -> hidden sm:block), keeping first/middle/last and every 8 seconds; full 9 ticks return at >=640px. Font size was NOT reduced.

Verified by reading the merged file, not by trusting the lane reports.
reconciliation.boundaryCall: The misc lane edited components/sections/Hero.tsx, which the hero lane also owned. Allowed: both files fall inside PUNCH.md's F2 exclusive scope (components/sections/**), and the two edits touch disjoint regions (RULER_TICKS markup vs the GSAP timeline). No cross-group violation.
reconciliation.accentColour: crimson only. The new scroll shadow uses an ink tint, the UtilityMenu uses paper + rule. No second accent introduced by any lane.
reconciliation.copySource: all human-readable copy still resolves from lib/data. SET / THEME / MOTION / LANG remain HUD marks, consistent with the existing treatment of those identifiers.

verification.notVerified: No browser, dev server or devtools was permitted for this pass. The nav horizontal budget, the 414px line-boundary clip and the ~84px mobile tick spacing are arithmetic from source constants, NOT re-measured renders. The original screenshots were taken before these fixes; no after-shots exist.

residualIssues: components/sections/Hero.tsx:468 still passes maxHeight="clamp(13rem, 40vh, 26rem)" rather than maxLines. The fluid 40vh term means the clip lands on a fractional line at most viewport heights — the exact defect maxLines was built to remove. It reads correctly at 1440x900 only because 40vh happens to resolve near a line boundary there. Not changed unilaterally: switching to maxLines trades the hero's viewport-responsive height for a fixed one, which is an art-direction call.
components/sections/GraphSeparation.tsx:373 has the same untreated arithmetic: maxHeight 24rem = 384px, minus py-3 = 360px / 26px = 13.85 lines, so line 14 is sheared.

CODE_LINE_HEIGHT = 26 in CodeBlock.tsx is a hardcoded pixel constant duplicating the CSS line box. If F1 executes P2-5 (collapsing the --text-* scale), this constant desyncs silently and the line-boundary guarantee degrades with no type error and no test.

Hero.tsx creates settleTimer via window.setTimeout but never clears it — there is no cleanup return and `void settleTimer` only silences the unused-variable lint. Benign today because settle() guards on el.isConnected and its worst effect is clearProps to the readable state, but it is a latent leak if the guard is ever relaxed.

The vast majority of PUNCH.md remains unexecuted. This pass closed four measured defects; P0-1 through P0-8 (fabricated data, the 11 generic fade-ups, signature-shot layout privilege, the 18-section metronome, section merges, dark-mode contrast, cursor trail, layout-property animation) are all still open.

knownDeviations.why: The four spines physically push each other; when spine n appears, spines 1..n-1 must actually yield space, and that displacement IS the meaning (the thickness a crushed paradigm leaves behind). Faking it with transform makes the creases overlap and the semantics collapse. Mitigated: the spines layer is an absolutely-positioned overlay inside the pinned viewport, so it is out of document flow; child count is fixed at 4; it fires at most 4 times in the whole page. No document-level reflow is possible.

Bottom padding is 1.45x top at the base breakpoint once the 74px fixed nav overlay is subtracted, but only ~1.05x at lg. Not corrected because the hero is min-h-dvh with a flex-1 middle that absorbs all slack — the hinge into the next section is the bottom rule + metaline, not the padding, so the gate's harm (a hero floating off the page) does not occur. Increasing pb blindly would trade a cosmetic ratio for real risk against gate 44b (fold fit), which could not be verified without a browser.
